dedupe_keys.name: hydrowires b1 monthly and weekly hydropower constraints

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes HydroWIRES B1 monthly and weekly hydropower generation targets and operating constraints for hundreds of United States plants. The Zenodo description says the products disaggregate EIA-923 observations and use RectifHyd flow information, with additional observed plant locations in version 1.3.0. The public release is free under CC0. It can calibrate dispatch constraints or validate generation targets in power-system simulations, including comparisons with data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower. A caveat is that a reconstructed weekly profile is not a direct meter record for every plant and period. Disaggregation assumptions, source identifiers and hydrological matching need checking before treating the bounds as operational limits. The package manifest and repository description were inspected without downloading the ZIP. Coverage is United States hydropower; no claim is made here about every plant's full-year completeness or the accuracy of the reconstructed constraints.
